title: Personal-Best Achievement Log
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vbt:rep
| eval est_1rm=round(load_kg*(1+reps/30),1)
| streamstats current=t max(est_1rm) as best_so_far by exercise
| eval new_pb=if(est_1rm>=best_so_far AND est_1rm>0,1,0)
| where new_pb=1
| table _time exercise est_1rm
description: Flags the moment you set a new personal best on any lift, capturing the milestones that make training rewarding.
value: Personal bests are the reward that keeps training fun; surfacing them automatically turns raw logs into a highlight reel.
implementation: Ingest reps and loads into `index=personal`; detect and log new personal bests per exercise.
visualization: Table of personal-best moments by exercise and date.
grandmaExplanation: It spots when you set a new personal record on a lift, capturing the milestones that make training satisfying.
